content:
Most ecommerce teams think of AI as a content tool. That's maybe 10% of the picture.

In this issue

  • 2. Personalized Product Discovery. "Customers who bought this also bought" is not personalization.
  • 3. Dynamic Pricing. Dynamic pricing scares merchants because it sounds like a race to the bottom.
  • 4. Inventory Demand Forecasting. Every merchant placing orders six months out based on last year's sales knows they're guessing.
  • 5. Catalog Enrichment and PIM Cleanup. Nobody puts "catalog cleanup" on a conference slide.
  • 6. Returns and Refunds Automation. Ask any ecommerce ops manager what they'd automate first and returns comes up every time.
  • 7. Content Localization. This is the workflow where the human share is highest.
  • 8. Email/SMS Retention Workflows. Klaviyo and Attentive built entire companies on this.
